 Nepal Premier League

 Live scores and commentary 
 20th T20, Kirtipur Mon 9 Nov Chitwan Rhinos Kathmandu Gorkhas Mon 9 Nov, 11:15 GMT 
 Predictions and form stats 
 Here are the Predictions for Nepal Premier League 2026, 19th Match - Pokhara Avengers vs Karnali Yaks and 20th Match - Chitwan Rhinos vs Kathmandu Gorkhas, to be played on the 9th of November at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
 Match Prediction - Pokhara Avengers v Karnali Yaks 
 LIVE SCORES - 19th Match - Pokhara Avengers vs Karnali Yaks (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 157
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137
 Current Form Pokhara Avengers: 
 Pokhara Avengers are currently placed at the bottom most position on points table with 4 losses to their credit. They have 0 point to their name.
 The top run scorer for Pokhara Avengers in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Kushal Bhurtel with 74 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Pokhara Avengers in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Shakib Al Hasan with 4 scalps under his belt .
 Pokhara Avengers have lost their previous match against Chitwan Rhinos by 30 runs.
 Chitwan Rhinos batted first and they posted a total of 151 for 6 in 20 overs. Arjun Saud and Dawid Malan gave a stable but very slow start to Chitwan Rhinos. Ravi Bopara played well and scored 35 runs in 28 balls. Dan Mousley and Kushal Malla disappointed but Sikandar Raza had their back. He smashed 37 runs off only 16 balls as Chitwan Rhinos managed to get to a competitive total of 151 on a very tough surface to bat on.
 During the chase, Pokhara Avengers lost the key wickets of Kushal Bhurtel and Yuvraj Samra quite early. Arjun Kumal fought hard at number 3. However, he kept losing partners in regular succession and Pokhara Avengers lost their steam in the middle overs. Kumal made 45 and once he got out, it was all over for Pokhara Avengers. They were bowled out for 121, losing the match by 30 runs.
 Current Form Karnali Yaks: 
 Karnali Yaks are currently placed at the 6th position on points table with 2 wins and 2 losses to their credit. They have 4 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Karnali Yaks in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Ariful Islam with 43 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Karnali Yaks in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Sompal Kami with 7 scalps under his belt .
 Karnali Yaks have lost their previous match against Sudurpaschim Royals by 39 runs.
 Sudurpaschim Royals batted first and they posted a total of 176 for 6 in 20 overs. Saif Zaib and Binod Bhandari started off very well for Sudurpaschim Royals. They collected 68 runs for the 1st wicket partnership and laid the foundation for a huge total. Zaib made 35 while Binod Bhandari scored 27 runs off 22 deliveries. Brandon McMullen and Ishan Pandey also played well and scored 24 and 23 runs respectively. On the back of such brilliant batting performances, Sudurpaschim Royals managed to reach a tall total of 176 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Karnali Yaks lost their way right from the word go. They were reduced to 46 for 4 in the 9th over itself. All of the hopes were further lost when Hussain Talat got out to Dipendra Singh Airee. David Miller fought hard and scored 93 runs off 55 balls but failed to win the game for Karnali Yaks as they eventually fell short by 39 runs.

 The top wicket taker for Kathmandu Gorkhas in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Jahandad Khan with 7 scalps under his belt.
 Kathmandu Gorkhas have won their previous match against Lumbini Lions by 36 runs.
 Kathmandu Gorkhas batted first and they posted a competitive total of 160 for 8 in 20 overs. Sahil Patel and David Warner started off very well for Kathmandu Gorkhas. They collected 104 runs for the 1st wicket partnership and completely dominated the opposition bowlers. Patel made 38 while Warner scored 66 runs in 50 deliveries. Sahan Arachchige also contributed very well with a whirlwind knock of 34 runs in only 15 balls to help Kathmandu Gorkhas get to 160 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Lumbini Lions lost 4 early wickets and looked to be in deep waters. Sundeep Jora fought hard and scored 44 runs but he too consumed 45 deliveries and it didn't help the team much. The lower order batters also gave up their arms too soon and Lumbini Lions were eventually bowled out for 124, losing the match by 36 runs.
